version.description: Version ID comment marker; usually auto-updated by the packaging system

mysql_server.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address

mysql_port.description: Port number to connect to MySQL (0 = use default)

mysql_opt.description: MySQL client options; leave as 0 unless you know what you're doing

mysql_database.description: Name of the MySQL database to use

mysql_user_table.description: Name of the table containing user data

mysql_login_field.description: Column name used as login identifier

mysql_home_field.description: Column name for user's home directory

mysql_name_field.description: Column name for user's full name (optional)
